maria (Support): Escalating — Ledgerly onboarding hit a blocking issue with embed ingestion after quota increase. Trial customer, onboarding session scheduled tomorrow, renewal decision in ~6 weeks. Need CS triage.
jenna (CSM): Ack. What symptoms? Is it a 4xx/5xx?
maria (Support): Customers are seeing series of 502s from ingest-service when uploading CSVs. Repro steps: small file works, larger CSVs fail with timeout. Error snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 502 Bad Gateway
INGEST: timeout waiting for worker (pid 1342)
```
alex (Solutions Eng): Curious if it's batching/worker mem spike after quota bump. Any recent model/quant changes?
maria (Support): No model changes on their side. They bumped from 10k -> 100k vectors in setup. Failures started ~90m after bump.
sam (SRE): I'll check worker queue and autoscale. @ops-bot please surface recent deploys.
ops-bot: deploy-notify — prod-ingest v2.14 deployed 2024-05-02T09:12:45Z by ci-pipeline (no rollbacks).
ajenna (CSM): (typo) jenna — We should prepare a short comms plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement to Ledgerly 2) ETA update in 2h 3) propose a temporary ingest window or reduced batch size and reschedule onboarding if needed. I can own customer comms.
alex (Solutions Eng): Workaround: instruct them to set batch_size=200 and retry. I'll prepare a short script and `curl` examples. Also can enable prefix-caching for incremental ingest.
sam (SRE): Hotfix path: revert prod-ingest config that increased worker concurrency, or scale up workers. If rollback quick, ETA ~30m. If scale, ETA ~20m but cost spike.
maria (Support): Customer contact: Samir (Ledgerly) — "samir@ledgerly.com". He's flagged as high-touch. He already pinged support and is anxious.
jenna (CSM): I'll send Samir: "Thanks — we see the issue, investigating now. Short-term workaround: reduce batch size; we will follow up within 2 hours with ETA. If needed we'll pause heavy ingests until stable." Tagging renewal team FYI.
alex (Solutions Eng): Script I will drop in #eng-runtime in 10m. Jenna, want me to include a one-liner they can paste?
jenna (CSM): Yes please — include exact curl and expected header. I'll include in the 10m note to customer.
maria (Support): Logging ticket #INC-9482 created and linked to their account. Adding Jenna + Alex + Sam.
sam (SRE): Quick status: worker queue high, scaling triggered but an instance failed healthcheck — investigating root cause. Will update at +30.
jenna (CSM): Closing loop: comms plan sent, I have the onboarding coach on standby to postpone session if we don't have stable ingest in 4h. Renewal risk: medium-high if onboarding stalls >1 week. Will escalate to AMs if needed.
maria (Support): Thanks team — leaving thread to CS to lead customer-facing updates. @alex @sam please ping here when you have ETA so I can update the internal ticket. :pray:
